attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Licensed Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE provided/approved through ASWB or ASWB jointly accredited providers, NASW national or state chapters, NBCC, APA, AMA, other state social work boards, academic institutions, providers approved by the OK social work board, OK Board of Behavioral Health or OK LADC Board; other events by individual Board approval (Form 505).
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the calendar year in which the licensee passed the licensure exam.
rules.audit_note: Licensees certify completion at renewal; Board staff may audit randomly or for cause each year; audited licensees submit verification with the renewal application.

topics.who: All licensees (ethics training as defined by the Board)

rules.notes: Licenses expire at the end of each calendar year; CE earned January–December. Holders of more than one license need 6 extra hours per additional license (Board FAQ: 22 hours for two specialties). Hardship exemptions possible.
rules.rule_quote: How many hours are required to renew my license? You are required to have 16 hours, three of which must be ethics.
